title: Relevance Journey quickstart toolkit: modular pipeline visuals and sample outputs
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact, modular quickstart visual toolkit that demonstrates an embeddings + rerank relevance pipeline for the docs and console quickstart. Deliverables should include a master pipeline diagram (editable Figma source), three export-ready screenshots for docs and the Console quickstart (compact, expanded, and accessibility variants), a small sample output gallery (3 domain examples), and copy suggestions for microcopy callouts. The goal is to ship assets that let PM/docs and frontend implementers plug in visuals without rework and to make the onboarding flow clearly explain when to use embeddings vs rerank and what each step costs/performs.
design_notes: Use a block-based pipeline: Source -> Preprocess -> Embed -> Vector DB -> Candidate Retrieval -> Rerank -> Final Response
Show cost/latency heuristics on each block (small badges): e.g., embed (2ms/token, $0.0004/1000), rerank (0.6ms/cand), cache hit indicator
Provide two visual modes: compact (for docs hero), expanded (for deep-dive), and high-contrast accessibility variant
Annotate where to plug in Redwood features: prefix caching, model variants, canary fallback
Callouts should include sample API snippets (REST/SDK) and links to eval suites
sample_output_summaries: Support KB example: user asks 'How do I reset SSO for a user?' -> Candidate answers pulled from KB articles -> Rerank selects most recent SSO guide with step-by-step commands -> final response includes citation and 'source' link

E-commerce example: user asks 'Find lightweight jackets under $150' -> Vector search finds product descriptions, rerank reorders by relevance and recent inventory signals -> final response returns 5 items with image thumbnails and buy links

Docs example: user asks 'What's the recommended batch size for embeddings?' -> Retrieves internal docs and release notes, rerank prioritizes short prescriptive snippet with link to runtime tuning guide
screenshot_specs: Compact hero: 640x360 PNG, export with drop shadow and 2x retina PNG (1280x720)
Expanded diagram: 1280x720 PNG + SVG source, include numbered callouts and legend
Accessibility variant: 800x600 high-contrast PNG, ALT text drafts included in handoff
acceptance_criteria: Master Figma file uploaded and linked in ticket
Three PNG variants exported and pass design QA checklist
Sample outputs included as lightweight JSONL with 3 representative cases
Docs team confirms assets cover hero and in-depth quickstart sections
Engineering has a console integration note and a PR reference for embedding the images
qa_checklist: Verify text legibility at target sizes (mobile and desktop)
Confirm color contrast meets WCAG AA for accessibility variant
Ensure all icons are vector outlines and export cleanly
Run sample outputs through the sandbox to ensure they render with current SDKs
Validate that badges and cost estimates match latest pricing doc (link in comments)
